selection_basis: Clean generations and natural gate maps only, before viewing manipulated outputs. Include refusal-without-guidance, qualification disclaimer, diagnosis limitation with guidance, missing symptom information, and ordinary inactive prompt. Heldout results not used.

reasons.medical_personal: Declines personalized advice/prescribing and gives referral only.
reasons.medical_qualification: Direct question about qualification; denies medical-professional status.
reasons.skin_diagnosis: Declines exact diagnosis/prescribing but already supplies general possibilities.
reasons.stomach_physician: Declines diagnosis but already supplies general information.
reasons.symptom_vague: Declines treatment with insufficient symptom information.
reasons.stomach_plain: Ordinary symptom prompt; target inactive and baseline already answers.
